sessions.phase_label: Backend and frontend integration, provider selection, and site content
Prize simplification, gated ebook delivery, and production launch preparation
Production minting, payment, dashboard, and access debugging
End-to-end verification, reward reconciliation, and launch support

requirements.title: Project Branding
requirements.definition: Use Project Rebuild as the current product name while retaining the conditional future BooksOnChain identity.
requirements.boundary_note: Covers the rendered project identity only; individual hero, FAQ, About, and Mission content remain separate Requirements.

requirements.title: Landing-Page Hero Presentation
requirements.definition: Present the landing-page hero with the approved headline, supporting text, mint CTA, hierarchy, and uncluttered responsive layout.
requirements.boundary_note: Owns the above-the-fold layout and CTA; the book-cover crop and broader mechanics copy can fail or change independently.

requirements.title: Landing-Page Mechanics Copy
requirements.definition: Render concise and accurate landing-page explanations of the mint, referral commission, prize opportunity, and sharing flow.
requirements.boundary_note: Covers product-mechanics messaging outside the FAQ; it excludes the hero layout and the underlying smart-contract rules.

requirements.title: Landing-Page Book Cover Presentation
requirements.definition: Display the complete ebook cover on the landing page at an aesthetically appropriate size without cropping, overlap, or distortion.
requirements.boundary_note: The landing-page cover had its own repeated sizing and cropping trajectory, separate from NFT-detail images and book-reader access.

requirements.title: Product FAQ Content
requirements.definition: Provide FAQ content that accurately explains the current mint, referral, prize, payment, wallet, resale, and support behavior.
requirements.boundary_note: Owns the rendered FAQ as a product-copy surface; each underlying behavior remains an independent Requirement.

requirements.title: About Project Rebuild Page
requirements.definition: Render the approved About Project Rebuild page structure and explanatory product copy.
requirements.boundary_note: The About page is independently editable and is not merged with the Mission page or FAQ.

requirements.title: Our Mission Page
requirements.definition: Render the approved Our Mission page with the project's purpose, community, rewards, innovation, and long-term vision content.
requirements.boundary_note: This independently requested page remains separate from About, FAQ, and landing-page mechanics copy.

requirements.title: Wallet Authentication
requirements.definition: Use wallet authentication through Sign-In with Ethereum for crypto flows requiring wallet ownership.
requirements.boundary_note: Wallet authentication can evolve independently from email dashboard access and unauthenticated public APIs.

requirements.title: Email Dashboard Authentication
requirements.definition: Allow non-wallet users to access the dashboard through simple email authentication such as magic links.
requirements.boundary_note: Owns authentication and registered-email state; general transactional email delivery is a separate Requirement.

requirements.title: Unauthenticated Public APIs
requirements.definition: Keep public data APIs, including leaderboards and pool values, accessible without authentication.
requirements.boundary_note: Public API access is independently configurable and is not an attribute of wallet or email authentication.

requirements.title: NFT Referral Code Identity
requirements.definition: Use each NFT's own mint number or token ID as its permanent referral code and display that identity in the appropriate product surfaces.
requirements.boundary_note: Owns code identity and display, while validation of an entered code is independently testable.

requirements.title: Referral Code Validation
requirements.definition: Accept only referral codes belonging to already minted NFTs, prevent self-referral through future token IDs, and show accurate valid or invalid feedback.
requirements.boundary_note: Input validation and its immediate feedback can fail without changing the NFT's permanent referral-code identity.

requirements.title: Code-Used Referral Commission
requirements.definition: When a valid referral code is used for a mint, credit and automatically pay the selected NFT holder the configured referral commission.
requirements.boundary_note: Covers commission award when a code is used; no-code random allocation and ticket issuance are separate mechanisms.

requirements.title: No-Referral Commission Allocation
requirements.definition: For a mint without a referral code, allocate the commission to a randomly selected existing NFT holder, subject to the accepted first-mint exception.
requirements.boundary_note: Commission allocation remained mandatory even while the no-code ticket rule was briefly negotiable, so the two are separate Requirements.

requirements.title: Commission Accounting Accuracy
requirements.definition: Accurately reflect awarded referral commissions in aggregate totals, leaderboards, dashboards, and per-NFT views.
requirements.boundary_note: Commission accounting followed a different failure and repair trajectory from ticket accounting and from the actual payout operation.

requirements.title: Top Affiliate Prizes
requirements.definition: Historical rank-based top-affiliate prize mechanism that was explicitly replaced by randomized block prizes.
requirements.boundary_note: This is retained as a removed historical Requirement rather than being folded into its Small and Big Block replacements.

requirements.title: Small Block Prize Mechanism
requirements.definition: Govern the independently evolving Small Block prize pool, sales trigger, winner count, prize amount, funding, and draw-cycle reset.
requirements.boundary_note: Winner count, prize value, and trigger are attributes of one Small Block mechanism; Big Block can be removed independently.

requirements.title: Big Block Prize Mechanism
requirements.definition: Govern the historical Big Block prize pool, trigger, winner count, prize amount, and ticket-cycle behavior.
requirements.boundary_note: Big Block had its own parameter changes and eventual removal while Small Block remained active.

requirements.title: Code-Used Prize Ticket Issuance
requirements.definition: Issue the configured active-draw prize ticket when a successful mint uses a valid referral code, with draw-specific expiration and reset behavior.
requirements.boundary_note: Ticket issuance is independently testable from the $5 commission and from no-code random ticket allocation.

requirements.title: No-Referral Ticket Allocation
requirements.definition: For a mint without a referral code, issue the ticket to a randomly selected existing NFT holder, subject to the accepted first-mint exception.
requirements.boundary_note: The client considered omitting no-code tickets while still requiring random commission allocation, demonstrating independent lifecycle potential.

requirements.title: Prize Ticket Accounting Accuracy
requirements.definition: Accurately reflect awarded prize tickets in aggregate totals, leaderboards, dashboards, and per-NFT views.
requirements.boundary_note: Ticket accounting was repaired and observed separately from random commission accounting and from ticket issuance itself.

requirements.title: Verifiable Random Winner Selection
requirements.definition: Use Chainlink VRF to select prize winners randomly, on-chain, and verifiably.
requirements.boundary_note: Random winner selection is independent from ticket issuance, pool funding, and the winner's claim interaction.

requirements.title: Prize Claim and Winner Notification Flow
requirements.definition: Expose winners and allow an eligible winner to claim a prize through a conditional claim action, with appropriate dashboard or email notification.
requirements.boundary_note: The post-draw claim interaction can change independently from draw selection and automatic referral commissions.

requirements.title: Aave Prize Pool Yield Integration
requirements.definition: Historical integration intended to deposit prize-pool funds into Aave so the pools could accrue yield.
requirements.boundary_note: Aave yield is an independently removable integration, not an attribute of the Small Block prize parameters.

requirements.title: Mint Price and Revenue Allocation
requirements.definition: Charge the configured fixed mint price and divide each successful primary sale among founder revenue, referral commission, and the active prize pool according to the current split.
requirements.boundary_note: The overall sale allocation is one tightly coupled business rule; actual commission payout and prize-pool operation have separate Requirements.

requirements.title: USDC Wallet Mint Flow
requirements.definition: Allow a connected wallet to approve USDC and complete an NFT mint, with the approval automatically followed by the actual mint.
requirements.boundary_note: USDC approval and mint execution had a failure trajectory distinct from ETH conversion and fiat checkout.

requirements.title: ETH Wallet Mint and Refund Flow
requirements.definition: Allow an ETH-funded wallet mint by converting only the amount required for the fixed USDC price, reverting on shortfall, and returning excess value according to the accepted refund design.
requirements.boundary_note: ETH swap routing, exact-output pricing, and excess refund form one payment-path mechanism separate from USDC minting.

requirements.title: Mint Payment Method Presentation
requirements.definition: Clearly identify available mint currencies and provide a usable choice among enabled wallet and card payment methods while hiding or disabling unavailable methods.
requirements.boundary_note: Method selection and disclosure can fail even when the underlying USDC or ETH contract path works.

requirements.title: Transak Fiat Mint Flow
requirements.definition: Provide a Transak-based card, Apple Pay, or Google Pay flow that converts fiat for an NFT mint, while allowing the fiat capability to be deferred from the initial crypto-only launch.
requirements.boundary_note: Provider selection and fiat-mint lifecycle belong together; the wallet provisioned for a walletless buyer is a separate behavior.

requirements.title: Fiat Buyer Wallet Provisioning
requirements.definition: Provide a walletless fiat buyer with a simple non-custodial wallet and a dashboard or email path for accessing the NFT, commissions, and prizes without initially managing a seed phrase.
requirements.boundary_note: Wallet creation and later reward access remain distinct from simply embedding the Transak payment widget.

requirements.title: Optional Mint Tipping
requirements.definition: Allow buyers to choose preset or custom tips during minting, process the tip as an explicit separate transfer when required, and avoid invalid founder self-tips.
requirements.boundary_note: Tipping has its own transfer, disclosure, and self-transfer behavior independent from the NFT purchase payment.

requirements.title: Mint Success Feedback
requirements.definition: Display mint-success feedback only after a genuine mint confirmation, show the correct token ID, and use reward wording appropriate to code-used and no-code mints.
requirements.boundary_note: Success-state correctness repeatedly failed independently of whether a payment approval or mint transaction succeeded.

requirements.title: Unlimited NFT Ebook Collection
requirements.definition: Offer the ebook as an unlimited-mint NFT collection in which each successful primary purchase creates a distinct NFT copy.
requirements.boundary_note: Owns collection supply and issuance semantics; individual payment paths and referral rules remain separate.

requirements.title: Secondary Royalty Enforcement
requirements.definition: Enforce the configured flat secondary-sale royalty through an ERC-721C-compatible collection and approved marketplace controls.
requirements.boundary_note: Royalty enforcement is independent from primary-mint pricing and from which sale types generate referral tickets.

requirements.title: NFT Resale State Transfer
requirements.definition: On NFT resale, transfer the book, permanent mint-number referral identity, earned badges, and applicable active ticket state to the purchaser while keeping expired tickets expired.
requirements.boundary_note: This owns state movement on resale rather than royalty collection or primary-mint reward issuance.

requirements.title: NFT Metadata Accuracy
requirements.definition: Generate each NFT's metadata and attributes from the correct live source so referral code, tickets, referrals, earnings, badges, image, and book links describe that NFT accurately.
requirements.boundary_note: Owns the per-token metadata projection; underlying commission and ticket award accounting remain separate Requirements.

requirements.title: Dashboard NFT Ownership Accuracy
requirements.definition: Show only successfully minted NFTs actually owned by the connected user and keep dashboard ownership counts synchronized with on-chain state.
requirements.boundary_note: Owned-NFT synchronization failed independently from public supply statistics and from metadata attribute values.

requirements.title: Public Mint and Prize Pool Statistics
requirements.definition: Display accurate public totals for mints, current mint number, prize-pool value, referrals, and related home-page statistics.
requirements.boundary_note: Public aggregate statistics can be wrong while a user's owned NFTs or per-NFT metadata are correct.

requirements.title: NFT Detail Asset Presentation
requirements.definition: Display the NFT cover image completely and correctly on NFT detail and dashboard surfaces, together with the appropriate owner book-access action.
requirements.boundary_note: Owns visual asset rendering and action visibility; successful decryption and reader navigation are separate Requirements.

requirements.title: Badge Catalog and Presentation
requirements.definition: Provide the approved badge set, labels, icons, and responsive arrangement in complete visually balanced rows.
requirements.boundary_note: Badge catalog and layout can change without altering the milestone logic that decides which badges are earned.

requirements.title: Badge Award Accuracy
requirements.definition: Award, display, and notify only badges whose configured referral or participation milestones have actually been reached.
requirements.boundary_note: Incorrect badge selection and notifications formed a separate failure path from badge visual arrangement.

requirements.title: Removable IPFS Book Storage
requirements.definition: Store the initial ebook PDF through Pinata-backed IPFS in a manner that preserves the client's ability to remove the hosted copy if needed.
requirements.boundary_note: Storage location and takedown control are distinct from ownership gating and reader behavior.

requirements.title: NFT-Holder-Only Book Access
requirements.definition: Gate the encrypted ebook through Lit Protocol so a valid NFT holder can decrypt and view it while a non-holder is denied access.
requirements.boundary_note: Owns authorization and decryption; mobile-wallet compatibility and page-navigation UX have independent failure trajectories.

requirements.title: Mobile Wallet Book Access
requirements.definition: Allow NFT holders using supported mobile wallet applications to complete the required ownership signature and open the gated book.
requirements.boundary_note: Desktop access worked while mobile-wallet access failed, providing a separate environment-specific trajectory.

requirements.title: Ebook Reader UX
requirements.definition: Use a read-only PDF viewer by default with usable persistent or recoverable page controls and an optional offline PDF download path.
requirements.boundary_note: Page navigation and download presentation can fail after authorization and decryption have already succeeded.

requirements.title: Transactional Email Delivery
requirements.definition: Reliably deliver configured verification, mint certificate, book-access, referral, badge, and prize notification emails through the selected email service.
requirements.boundary_note: Owns delivery of product-generated messages; the separate email-authentication Requirement owns dashboard sign-in state.

requirements.title: Base Network Deployment
requirements.definition: Deploy and operate the NFT and supporting on-chain flows on Base rather than another blockchain.
requirements.boundary_note: Base is a project-wide confirmed technology choice, not a Family-level inheritance rule for unrelated behaviors.

requirements.title: Contract Upgrade Data Continuity
requirements.definition: Apply contract replacements or upgrades according to the currently approved migration policy, including whether numbering restarts or existing users, NFTs, and data must be retained.
requirements.boundary_note: This operational data-migration obligation is separate from the functional rules contained in each contract version.

requirements.title: Production Site Availability
requirements.definition: Keep the production website reachable and functional rather than returning gateway or failed-deployment errors.
requirements.boundary_note: This runtime constraint concerns whole-site reachability, not whether any particular mint or dashboard feature works after loading.

requirements.title: Contract Event Ingestion
requirements.definition: Configure backend event ingestion to capture and route Base contract logs for mints, referrals, tickets, and related state synchronization.
requirements.boundary_note: The webhook is an independently configured infrastructure behavior supporting several product Requirements without owning their business rules.

requirements.title: Wallet Security Warning Remediation
requirements.definition: Complete the applicable verification or false-positive reporting steps so supported wallets and browsers do not flag the production site as likely malicious.
requirements.boundary_note: This is a concrete production-access remediation task, not a generic security or QA Requirement.

requirements.title: Mauritius Landing-Page Geoblock
requirements.definition: Block users located in Mauritius from accessing the Project Rebuild landing page.
requirements.boundary_note: The geoblock is an access rule separate from the business's Mauritius location and payment-provider eligibility.

requirements.title: Landing-Page Support Form
requirements.definition: Provide a help or contact form accessible from the landing page or footer with fields for user identity, subject, and support inquiry.
requirements.boundary_note: The in-product contact form is independent from the externally hosted Discord community server.

requirements.title: Discord Community and Support Server
requirements.definition: Provide an operational Project Rebuild Discord server with onboarding, announcements, community discussion, support, feedback, and bug-report channels.
requirements.boundary_note: This is an independently requested operational support environment, not ordinary conversation or a generic support promise.

requirements.title: Mint Number One Ownership Assignment
requirements.definition: Assign the NFT carrying mint and affiliate code number one to the client-specified wallet.
requirements.boundary_note: This is a one-off on-chain data obligation rather than a general NFT transfer policy.

unresolved_candidates.description: Hosting alternatives are discussed, but the supplied history does not establish a client-confirmed hosting provider.
The referenced additional tweak is not present in the message text or supplied context and cannot be mapped to a Requirement.
The client specifies automatic seedless wallet provisioning for fiat buyers, but the exact provider-supported custody and recovery model is not confirmed in the supplied evidence.
It remains unclear whether an already authenticated NFT holder must always provide a fresh ownership signature before viewing the book.
A Super Admin dashboard document is welcomed, but there is no clear client decision to implement the proposed dashboard now rather than merely review it for possible future work.
